1) Urgency granted.

2 & 4) Through this petition, Petitioner Ameer Hamza Shah son of Abdul Aziz Shah,
who is stated to be in UAE, through his father Abdul Aziz Shah seeks
protective/transitory bail in FIR No.65/2026 under Sections 5 and 23 of the Foreign
Exchange Regulation Act, 1947, read with Sections 34 and 109, PPC, pending before
the competent Court. It is contended that the Petitioner is prepared to surrender before
the trial Court in the aforesaid FIR and is arriving in Pakistan on 01.11.2026 but
apprehends his arrest at the hands of respondent/complainant on his arrival at Jinnah
International Airport, Karachi, hence this petition. Learned counsel submits that the
body: Petitioner has a confirmed return flight booking from Dubai to Karachi bearing Booking Reference No. GPKHY3 and Ticket No. EK 709286502-BLUE. As per the confirmed itinerary, the Petitioner is scheduled to depart from Dubai on 01.11.2026 at 19:55 hours aboard Fly Dubai Flight No. FZ 329 and is expected to arrive in Karachi on the same date at 22:55 hours, all timings being local. Copy of the confirmed air ticket and itinerary is annexed with the petition. Father of the Petitioner is present before this Court and undertakes that the Petitioner shall appear before the competent Court within the stipulated period.

Since Petitioner is prepared to surrender before the trial Court, without touching the merits of the case, protective/transitory bail is granted to him for a period of fifteen (15) days from today, subject to furnishing solvent surety in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) and P.R. bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Nazir of this Court.

This order shall cease to have its effect after expiry of fifteen (15) days from today or when the Petitioner surrenders before the concerned trial Court, whichever is earlier. The instant petition alongwith office objection stands disposed of.
Judge Head of the Const. Benches J u d g e SAJID
